doc.brief: Defines how content overflowing a given area should be handled.
doc.md:
Defines how content overflowing a given area should be handled.

This is used in [`Widget.set_overflow()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#method:set_overflow). The
[`Widget:overflow`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:overflow) property is modeled after the
CSS overflow property, but implements it only partially.

hidden.brief: Content is clipped to the bounds of the area.
hidden.md:
Content is clipped to the bounds of the area. Content
  outside the area is not drawn and cannot be interacted with.

visible.md:
No change is applied. Content is drawn at the specified
  position.
